read_loop: request=min(65536,file_size_before+1-read_returned); stop on observed EOF; require returned=file_size_before, complete hash and before/after metadata match
runtime_catalogue: each item requires bytes; exact st_size must match; K<=min(32768,approved runtime_files); sum(bytes)<=approved runtime_source_bytes before hash loop
policy_limits: pre_qpc_accounting_limits five positive source-bound metrics <= independent R2 approved pre_qpc_* maxima; null/missing rejects
bootstrap: policy+approval reads precede configuring limits; bounded source sizes; configure checks their already charged cost before further reads
reserved_close: one pre-QPC IO call reserved within io_attempts because only one source/PE FileIO may be open; read refusal leaves a close admission
source_identity: read_id +kind+path SHA256; exact path available from original pinned inputs/runtime catalog; existing self.pins unchanged, no original mandatory field replaced; no native FileId measurement
repeat_policy: every read instance charged separately, including repeated identical source paths/catalog entries
hash_count: 20+K complete whole-source SHA computations on successful validation; PE row is fragment-only, hash_complete=false and file_size_before=null
unknowns: durable diagnostics if validation fails before output ownership
